title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving SRH and GBV response services to displaced and vulnerable IDP women and girls and host communities affected by the insecurity in the Southern districts of Cabo Delgado and Nampula.

description.narrative:
Women and girls continue to suffer the greatest humanitarian impacts of the conflict in Cabo Delgado. The recent attacks in Ancuabe and Erati districts between July and September 2022 led to increased displacements (approximately 1 million IDPs, according to the IOM DTM Matrix round 16), worsening the humanitarian situation in the districts that were already hosting large numbers of IDPs, including Ancuabe, Montepuez, Chiúre, Metuge and Pemba.
To respond to the increasing demand for essential Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHRs) and Gender- Based Violence prevention, mitigation and response services due to this humanitarian crisis in Cabo Delgado and Nampula, UNFPA and implementing partners are reinforcing the provision of such services in the target districts with focus on women, girls, adolescents and youth in accommodation centers and host communities.
This $550,000 project targets 26,700 affected people with Health - SRH activities and 12,630 with its Protection - GBV engagement.
